column9: It is our duty to praise the Master of all, to ascribe greatness to the Creator of the beginning: that he has not made us like the nations of the lands and has not placed us like the families of the earth, that he has not set our portion like theirs nor our lot like all their multitude. column9: Blessed is the name of the Master of the world; blessed is your crown and your place. May your good will be with your people Israel for ever; show your people the redemption of your right hand in your Temple, bring us of the goodness of your light, and accept our prayer in mercy. May it be your will to lengthen our life in goodness, and let me be counted among the righteous, so that you have mercy on me and guard me and all that is mine and your people Israel's. You feed and sustain all; you rule over all; you rule over kings, and the kingdom is yours. I am a servant of the Holy One, blessed be he, before whom and before whose glorious Torah I bow at every time. Not in any person do I trust, and not on any angel do I rely, but on the God of heaven, who is the God of truth, whose Torah is truth and whose prophets are truth, and who abounds in deeds of goodness and truth. In him I trust, and to his holy and glorious name I utter praises. May it be your will to open my heart to Torah, to fulfil the requests of my heart and the heart of all your people Israel, for good, for life and for peace.
